Review Figma?

Reviewers see Figma as the default place where product design happens: a browser-based workspace that lets designers, developers, founders, and clients work in the same file, comment in context, prototype quickly, and hand off cleaner specs. Many also praise its components, auto-layout, plugins, and Dev Mode for keeping systems consistent and speeding design-to-code work. The main complaints are familiar: large or messy files can lag, some features take time to learn, offline use is limited, and a few reviewers dislike parts of pricing, admin, exporting, or version control.

Review Figma?

Reviewers see Figma as the default workspace for UI and product design: browser-based, easy to share, and especially strong at real-time collaboration, comments, prototyping, components, auto-layout, and design-system consistency. Many say it reduces version chaos and speeds handoff between design, product, and engineering. Founders of LottieFiles, Locofy.ai, and Fundraisly echo that it supports adjacent workflows and keeps teams in one file. The main complaints are familiar: lag on large or crowded files, limited offline use, some learning curve, and occasional friction around Dev Mode, exporting, or billing.
